message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What You Need to Know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house‑rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Plus 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck. 2. Deal 7 cards to each player. 3. Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile. 4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a Wild Draw Four, the next player draws four cards and loses a turn). | | **Turn Play** | 1. On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches either the color, number, or symbol of the top discard. 2. If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction (in 2‑player games it acts like a Skip).
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | **Wild Draw Four Challenge** | If you suspect the player who played a Wild Draw Four had a playable card, you may challenge.
• If the challenger is correct (the player had a playable card), the challenger draws 4 cards.
• If the challenger is wrong, the challenger draws 6 cards. | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, the round ends. That player scores points based on the cards left in opponents’ hands: number cards = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. First to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | | **House Rules (optional)** | • **Stacking** – Allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing.
• **No “Uno” Call** – Players must say “Uno” when they have one card left; failing to do so may incur a penalty.
• **Custom Decks** – Use themed decks or add extra action cards. | **Quick Tips** - Keep track of the current color; if you’re holding a Wild, you can change the color to suit your strategy. - In a 2‑player game, Reverse acts like Skip, so you’ll need to remember that. - If you’re playing with the “challenge” rule, be careful when calling a Wild Draw Four; you’ll need to prove you had a playable card. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
